messages.english: Field seed sourcing · cycles without nursery raising
messages.translation: Upataji wa mbegu za shambani · mizunguko isiyo na ukuzaji kitaluni

messages.english: Use accepted saved field cycles that have no nursery phase. No nursery phase does not establish botanical direct sowing. Enter your own gross whole-seed requirement; final plant positions are not seed counts.
messages.translation: Tumia mizunguko ya shambani iliyohifadhiwa na kukubaliwa ambayo haina awamu ya kitalu. Kutokuwa na awamu ya kitalu hakuthibitishi upandaji wa moja kwa moja wa mbegu za mimea. Ingiza hitaji lako ghafi la idadi kamili ya mbegu; nafasi za mwisho za mimea si hesabu za mbegu.

messages.english: Planning only, not a whole-farm purchase list. No stock is recorded, order placed or plan saved. Unknown counts are not zero. Nursery equipment and a nursery review horizon are not required for this separate field worksheet.
messages.translation: Mipango tu, si orodha ya ununuzi wa shamba zima. Hakuna hisa iliyorekodiwa, agizo lililowekwa au mpango uliohifadhiwa. Hesabu zisizojulikana si sifuri. Vifaa vya kitalu na upeo wa mapitio ya kitalu havihitajiki kwa lahajedwali hii tofauti ya shambani.

messages.english: Check saved field cycles for seed sourcing
messages.translation: Kagua mizunguko ya shambani iliyohifadhiwa kwa upataji wa mbegu

messages.english: Whole seed count, including any allowances you have chosen. No allowances or rates are added here. Blank means unknown; an explicitly confirmed zero is a planning entry.
messages.translation: Hesabu kamili ya mbegu kwa idadi kamili, ikijumuisha ziada yoyote uliyochagua. Hakuna ziada au viwango vinavyoongezwa hapa. Nafasi tupu inamaanisha haijulikani; sifuri iliyothibitishwa wazi ni ingizo la mipango.
Ongeza kikundi cha ugavi wa shambani
Kagua upataji wa mbegu za shambani
Pakua CSV ya upataji wa mbegu za shambani

messages.english: The CSV includes your entered supply-group labels exactly, including whitespace. Leave out information you do not want in the file. Private saved association IDs and individual variety or lot references are not included.
messages.translation: CSV inajumuisha lebo za kikundi cha ugavi ulizoingiza kikamilifu, ikijumuisha nafasi wazi. Acha taarifa ambazo hutaki ziwepo kwenye faili. Vitambulisho vya faragha vya muungano vilivyohifadhiwa na marejeleo binafsi ya aina au fungu hayajumuishwi.
DEMO · lahajedwali ya sampuli ya muda ya mipango.
